grammar_title: 时态综合复习(过去/现在/将来 各时态辨析与运用)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第四册 Unit 1 Using language: Review of tenses。题干靠时间状语等标志强制唯一时态,干扰项为其他时态,句子地道、围绕未来/科技/抉择主题。

points.point: 现在时态(一般/进行/完成/完成进行,靠标志词判断)
points.overview: every day/usually/as a rule 等→一般现在;now/at the moment/Look!→现在进行;already/so far/up to now/this is the first time→现在完成;all morning/for ... and still→现在完成进行。

points.point: 过去时态(一般/进行/完成/过去将来,靠标志词判断)
points.overview: in 1899/ago/after leaving→一般过去;while/at eight last night→过去进行;by the time/before/by 2010→过去完成;promised/never imagined that ... would→过去将来。

points.point: 将来表达(will/be going to/现在进行表将来/将来进行/将来完成)
points.overview: I think ... probably→will;already decided/evidence→be going to;tomorrow at three(固定安排)→现在进行表将来;at this time next year→将来进行;by + 将来时间→将来完成。

questions.stem: Every spring, our school ____ a science fair where students show their inventions.
questions.explanation: Every spring 表习惯性反复发生,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: Look! The new delivery robot ____ along the pavement towards the school gate.
questions.explanation: Look! 提示此刻正在进行的动作,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: So far, researchers ____ three safe new ways to store solar power.
questions.explanation: So far 表到目前为止的成果,用现在完成时。

questions.stem: My brother ____ on his coding project all morning, and he still hasn't taken a break.
questions.explanation: all morning + still 强调动作从过去持续到现在且仍在继续,用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: As a rule, our class ____ a coding lesson on Friday afternoons.
questions.explanation: As a rule + on Friday afternoons 表惯例,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: At the moment, engineers ____ a bridge that cars will one day cross without drivers.
questions.explanation: At the moment 表此刻正在进行,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: Up to now, the company ____ over a thousand smart watches this year.
questions.explanation: Up to now + this year 表到目前的累计结果,用现在完成时。

questions.stem: She ____ for the future job market for two years, and she is still studying hard.
questions.explanation: for two years + still 强调持续至今且未停止,用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: According to the timetable, the high-speed train to the tech park ____ at seven every morning.
questions.explanation: 时刻表 + every morning 表固定安排,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: Right now, the city ____ thousands of charging points for electric cars.
questions.explanation: Right now 表此刻正在进行,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: This is the first time I ____ a self-driving car move on a real road.
questions.explanation: This is the first time + that 从句用现在完成时。

questions.stem: The programmers ____ the new app since this morning, and they don't plan to stop yet.
questions.explanation: since this morning + don't plan to stop 强调持续进行,用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: My grandfather ____ his tablet twice a day to read the news about new technology.
questions.explanation: twice a day 表习惯频率,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: At present, our company ____ more young AI engineers than ever before.
questions.explanation: At present + more ... than ever 表此阶段不断变化的情形,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: So far this term, our school ____ every classroom with a smart screen.
questions.explanation: So far this term 表到目前为止已完成,用现在完成时。

questions.stem: My sister ____ about her future career all day, and she still can't decide.
questions.explanation: all day + still 强调持续动作,用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: Everyone knows that clean energy ____ an important part in modern life.
questions.explanation: knows that 引出的普遍事实,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: Listen! The science teacher ____ about how robots will change our jobs.
questions.explanation: Listen! 提示此刻正在进行,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: I can't join the coding club yet, because I ____ my homework so far.
questions.explanation: yet + so far 表到现在为止尚未完成,用现在完成时(否定)。

questions.stem: Our teacher ____ us about future careers all week, and the lessons continue tomorrow.
questions.explanation: all week + continue tomorrow 强调持续进行,用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: Ernest Hemingway ____ a local newspaper as a young reporter after leaving high school.
questions.explanation: after leaving high school 表过去某时点完成的动作,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: While Doyle ____ for patients in his clinic, he wrote some of his first detective stories.
questions.explanation: While 引导的背景动作与过去另一动作同时发生,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: By the time the results came out, she ____ her future major.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去动作,表示更早发生的动作,用过去完成时。

questions.stem: As a boy, Doyle promised himself that one day he ____ a famous writer.
questions.explanation: promised 是过去时,从句表从过去看的将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: Arthur Conan Doyle ____ in Scotland in 1859.
questions.explanation: in 1859 表过去明确时间,出生用一般过去时 was born。

questions.stem: This time last year, I ____ about which university to apply to.
questions.explanation: This time last year 表过去某时刻正在进行,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: Before the smartphone appeared, few people ____ that a phone could replace a computer.
questions.explanation: Before + 过去动作,表更早的过去,用过去完成时。

questions.stem: She told me on Monday that she ____ to study robotics the following year.
questions.explanation: told 是过去时,was going to 表从过去看的打算(过去将来)。

questions.stem: The first home computer ____ on sale more than forty years ago.
questions.explanation: ago 表过去明确时间,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: I ____ a documentary about future cities when the power suddenly went off.
questions.explanation: 过去某动作进行中被 when 引导的短暂动作打断,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: After she ____ all the advantages and disadvantages, she finally made up her mind.
questions.explanation: After + 先发生的动作,后接 finally made,用过去完成时表先后。

questions.stem: Nobody guessed that the small start-up ____ a giant company one day.
questions.explanation: guessed 是过去时,从句表从过去看的将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: In his early years, Doyle ____ as a doctor in a small town.
questions.explanation: In his early years 表过去一段时间内的事实,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: At eight o'clock last night, my team ____ our plan for the future-tech show.
questions.explanation: At eight o'clock last night 表过去某时刻正在进行,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: When I arrived at the lab, the others ____ the experiment, so I had missed it.
questions.explanation: 动作发生在 arrived 之前(so I had missed it),用过去完成时。

questions.stem: As a child, Steve Jobs never imagined that his ideas ____ the whole world.
questions.explanation: imagined 是过去时,从句表从过去看的将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: The teacher ____ us a questionnaire about our goals at the start of last term.
questions.explanation: at the start of last term 表过去明确时间,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: While the robots ____ the heavy boxes, the workers checked the software.
questions.explanation: While 引导的动作与另一过去动作同时发生,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: By 2010, smartphones ____ the way millions of people lived and worked.
questions.explanation: By 2010 表到过去某时间为止已完成,用过去完成时。

questions.stem: When she left school, she had no idea what job she ____ in ten years' time.
questions.explanation: 主句过去时,had no idea what ... 表从过去看的将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: This time next year, we ____ in our own future-tech lab.
questions.explanation: This time next year 表将来某时刻正在进行,用将来进行时。

questions.stem: I've already decided: I ____ artificial intelligence at university next year.
questions.explanation: already decided + next year 表事先定好的打算,用 be going to。

questions.stem: I can't meet you on Friday — I ____ a robotics workshop that afternoon.
questions.explanation: on Friday + that afternoon 表已定好的安排,用现在进行时表将来。

questions.stem: By the time you come back next month, our team ____ the new electric car.
questions.explanation: By the time + 将来动作,表在那之前完成,用将来完成时。

questions.stem: I think robots ____ many boring jobs for us in the future.
questions.explanation: I think ... in the future 表对将来的预测,用 will。

questions.stem: Don't call me at nine tomorrow — I ____ my final coding exam at that exact moment.
questions.explanation: at that exact moment(将来某时刻)动作正在进行,用将来进行时。

questions.stem: Look how fast the battery is dropping — the robot ____ very soon.
questions.explanation: 由眼前迹象推断即将发生,用 be going to。

questions.stem: Scientists believe that by 2050 humans ____ a base on Mars.
questions.explanation: by 2050(将来时间点)之前完成,用将来完成时。

questions.stem: I ____ my future career plan to the class tomorrow at ten.
questions.explanation: tomorrow at ten 表已安排好的活动,用现在进行时表将来。

questions.stem: Don't worry about the broken sensor — I ____ it for you right now.
questions.explanation: right now 提出当场临时决定/主动帮忙,用 will。

questions.stem: This time next week, we ____ our new app to investors in Shanghai.
questions.explanation: This time next week 表将来某时刻正在进行,用将来进行时。

questions.stem: By the end of this course, you ____ how to build a simple robot.
questions.explanation: By the end of this course(将来时间)之前完成,用将来完成时。

questions.stem: She has made up her mind — she ____ a coding club at her school next term.
questions.explanation: made up her mind + next term 表已定的打算,用 be going to。

questions.stem: I'm sure clean energy ____ much cheaper in the coming years.
questions.explanation: I'm sure ... in the coming years 表对将来的预测,用 will。

questions.stem: I'm busy this weekend — I ____ my grandparents to see their new smart home on Saturday.
questions.explanation: this weekend + on Saturday 表已安排好的活动,用现在进行时表将来。

questions.stem: Don't expect a reply in the afternoon; I ____ in the future-skills seminar all day tomorrow.
questions.explanation: all day tomorrow 表将来一整段时间内持续进行,用将来进行时。

questions.stem: By the time you finish reading this article, scientists ____ another new gadget.
questions.explanation: By the time + 将来动作,表在那之前完成,用将来完成时。

questions.stem: If the old laptop is too slow, we ____ a faster one for the lab.
questions.explanation: If 引导的条件状语从句,主句表将来的决定,用 will。

questions.stem: Why are you carrying those wires and chips? — I ____ my own smart speaker this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 由前面准备好的材料看出事先的打算,用 be going to。

questions.stem: At this time next year, many of us ____ at university, far away from home.
questions.explanation: At this time next year 表将来某时刻正在进行,用将来进行时。
